description: Historical-ingestion manifest for SENTINEL. Registers deep-backfill sources and their connectors; scripts/historical_ingest.py --run executes every source whose connector_type has a runner and records the rest as skipped with a reason.

sources.label: GDELT API
sources.notes: Best used as one historical layer, not a complete substitute for outlet archives.

sources.label: ACLED Structured Feed
sources.notes: Structured conflict/event layer, not a news archive. Ingested as events (not articles) through the ACLED path in pipeline_core.py, so the article runner skips it.

sources.label: InSight Crime
sources.notes: Good candidate for deeper archive scraping where the REST API exposes older posts.

sources.label: El Faro
sources.notes: Requires validation of archive depth and a confirmed WordPress REST endpoint before it is enabled; the runner skips sources without an endpoint.

sources.label: Americas Quarterly
sources.notes: Same WordPress REST endpoint the fast pipeline already uses for archive collection.

sources.label: NACLA
sources.notes: Same WordPress REST endpoint the fast pipeline already uses for archive collection.

sources.label: El País América
sources.notes: Needs a dedicated connector with article-date pagination and access constraints handled explicitly.

sources.label: Folha de S.Paulo
sources.notes: Potentially valuable, but requires a source-specific archive strategy.

sources.label: NewsAPI Everything
sources.notes: 30-day history on the current plan; use scripts/run_pipeline.py --since for recent backfill. Not run by the historical article runner.
